algorithms.name: conservative bounds and stroke expansion
algorithms.preserved: filled/stroked extents, full-tile invalid bounds, hypot/sqrt/miter/square cap, pixel margins and source offsets

algorithms.name: boundary and controlled clip marking
algorithms.preserved: 200M marking work, unique bitmap count, chain/child overhead, actual filled-edge visits, two traversals, both-pass invalid inverse/full-mask fallback

algorithms.name: scanline events / AVL rows
algorithms.preserved: five offsets .125/.375/.5/.625/.875, original edge and shape event ties, 64-level AVL cap, ascending painter/edge order, removal node state

algorithms.name: uniform fill / crossing heapsort / winding
algorithms.preserved: uniform color/filled/stroke eligibility, one edge, >4096 fallback, 8MiB run bound, x/edge ties, grouped winding/parity and infinities, exact crossing setup costs

algorithms.name: fast runs / interval ranges / containment
algorithms.preserved: view coverage and bitmap transitions, half-open runs/intervals, five slots, exact binary comparisons

algorithms.name: exact complete work preflight
algorithms.preserved: 200M base, 1048576 ramp, 24576/pixel, 16B cap, all event/lookup/stroke/grid/setup/row/run/fast/scalar/sample/aux costs and offset-0 refusal

algorithms.name: admission / lifetime / atomic state
algorithms.preserved: one source owner/ledger, requested/actual capacities and metadata admitted before publication, old/new overlap, reusable backup storage, no per-row allocation, unconditional failure cleanup

operations.name: bounds
operations.signature: fn build_bounds(view: SceneView<'_>, map: ViewMapping, resources: &dyn KernelResources, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<BoundsSet>; fn mark_boundaries(view: SceneView<'_>, map: ViewMapping, resources: &dyn KernelResources, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<BoundaryMask>; fn mark_clip_boundaries(view: SceneView<'_>, map: ViewMapping, boundary: &mut BoundaryMask, resources: &dyn KernelResources, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<()>; fn boundary_test(mask: &BoundaryMask, pixel: usize) -> bool
operations.contract: Bounds include every paintable scalar sample: caps/joins/dashes/clips. Full boundary marking on invalid clip inverse. Preserve conservative degenerate/full-tile cases; 200M boundary-work cap; own/drop arrays. KernelResources is passed explicitly to operations requiring clip/stroke queries; lower writer consumes the shared interface and the coordinator supplies actual implementations.

operations.signature: fn create_scanlines(view: SceneView<'_>, bounds: &BoundsSet, map: ViewMapping, resources: &dyn KernelResources, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<ScanlineIndex>; fn reset_scanlines(index: &mut ScanlineIndex); fn build_row(index: &mut ScanlineIndex, view: SceneView<'_>, pixel_y: u32, rows: &mut RowBuffers, resources: &dyn KernelResources, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<usize>
operations.contract: Original event/tree algorithm, 5 samples rows, active capacities explicit, no hidden allocations per row; ascending shape painter order, original tiebreaks. KernelResources is passed explicitly to operations requiring clip/stroke queries; lower writer consumes the shared interface and the coordinator supplies actual implementations.

operations.name: fill cache
operations.signature: fn create_fill_cache(view: SceneView<'_>, resources: &dyn KernelResources, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<FillCache>; fn eligible(cache: &FillCache, shape: ShapeId) -> bool; fn color(view: SceneView<'_>, shape: ShapeId) -> Option<[u8;4]>; fn build_fill_row(cache: &mut FillCache, view: SceneView<'_>, shape: ShapeId, y: u32, map: ViewMapping, rows: &RowBuffers, resources: &dyn KernelResources, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<FillRowWork>; fn build_runs(cache: &mut FillCache, view: SceneView<'_>, bounds: PixelBounds, y: u32, boundary: &BoundaryMask, map: ViewMapping, resources: &dyn KernelResources, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<usize>; fn pixel_runs(cache: &FillCache) -> &[PixelRun]; fn interval_pixel_range(view: SceneView<'_>, bounds: PixelBounds, map: ViewMapping, sample_offset: f64, interval: FillInterval) -> Result<(TableRange,usize)>; fn fill_contains(cache: &FillCache, sample_row: usize, x: f64) -> (bool,usize)
operations.contract: FillRowWork records edge_visits/work_units. Entire uniform fill eligibility/exclusions, heap sort crossings/winding/interval algorithms and binary comparisons stay; >4096-edge shapes use original scalar fallback rather than refusal. KernelResources is passed explicitly to operations requiring clip/stroke queries; lower writer consumes the shared interface and the coordinator supplies actual implementations.

operations.name: preflight
operations.signature: fn work_budget(width: u32, height: u32) -> u64; fn preflight(view: SceneView<'_>, scratch: &mut RasterScratch, map: ViewMapping, stats: &mut WorkStats, resources: &dyn KernelResources, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<()>
operations.contract: Exact ramp min(16e9,200e6+max(0,pixels-1048576)*24576), all clip/paint/stroke/grid/dash/interval/boundary/row costs charged, identical count to real traversal including fast fill branches; cancellation is separate. No ThreadLocal budget leakage across jobs. KernelResources is passed explicitly to operations requiring clip/stroke queries; lower writer consumes the shared interface and the coordinator supplies actual implementations.

production_surface: fill_color(SceneView, ShapeId): allocation-free first-edge color lookup
legacy: Historical Vec-only entry points and allocating helpers are cfg(test), private and absent from normal builds. Original unit fixture implementations/assertions remain preserved. Production exposes owning-job engines plus allocation-free fill_color and internal shared helpers.
remaining_composition: Actual native DecodeOperations/ControlledKernelResources/sample/FlatKernel adapters, renderer pixels/hash/performance/app acceptance remain coordinator integration gates.
